trials.notes: Correctly chose WP_HTML_Tag_Processor for flat source-order last-tag mutation. Used documented next_tag, set_bookmark, seek, add_class, and get_updated_html. The found flag plus repeated literal bookmark matches the docs' last-match bookmark pattern. Passed all 6 cases with no _doing_it_wrong records.

Same correct Tag Processor/bookmark approach as the reference. All called methods are documented in the rendered files, and seek is guarded by prior successful traversal state. Uses add_class rather than manual class rewriting, so existing classes are handled idiomatically. Passed all 6 cases with no _doing_it_wrong records.

Correct processor and documented linear scan pattern. Reuses one bookmark to remember the last h2, seeks back once, applies add_class, then returns get_updated_html. Lowercase h2 is valid because tag-name matching is documented as ASCII case-insensitive. Passed all 6 cases with no _doing_it_wrong records.

failure_analysis: No hidden cases failed in any trial. The docs worked well for this task: the Tag Processor overview explicitly says to use it for flat source-order work like first/last/Nth matching tags; next_tag() documents string tag queries, case-insensitive matching, and that comments/raw text are not matched as tags; the Bookmarks section gives the exact reusable-bookmark pattern for remembering the last match; the CSS class section explains add_class as safe with absent or existing class attributes; and get_updated_html is identified as the correct way to read queued edits. Near-misses were minor: trials 1 and 2 returned the original input directly when no h2 was found, but that is equivalent because no edits were queued; none checked set_bookmark's return value, but the docs' own last-match recipe uses the same found-flag pattern with one literal bookmark name.

doc_gaps.problem: The last-match recipe is clear, but it does not state the policy choice when the final next_tag() returns false because parsing paused at an incomplete trailing token. A user doing streaming or complete-source validation may need to avoid mutating the previous match until input completeness is known.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Add a short note to last-match examples: after the scan, edits apply to the last complete matched tag; if the caller requires complete input, check paused_at_incomplete_token() before seeking back and mutating.

doc_gaps.problem: The method-level entry only says it adds a class. The important contract that add_class safely creates the class attribute, appends to existing classes, and avoids duplicates is mainly in the prose overview.
doc_gaps.suggestion: Add one method-doc sentence summarizing those semantics and cross-reference the CSS class section, so method-index readers do not fall back to manual class-attribute string manipulation.
